# Industrial Platform Agent Tools

Industrial Platform exposes paid MCP tools for autonomous AI agents.

## Preferred endpoint

https://mcp.apify.com?tools=industrial_platform/research-brief-agent,industrial_platform/web-change-intelligence,industrial_platform/web-metadata-intelligence,industrial_platform/article-content-intelligence,industrial_platform/pdf-text-intelligence,industrial_platform/sitemap-intelligence&payment=x402

Payment: direct x402, USDC on Base.

## Active tools

- research-brief-agent — cited multi-source web research — $1.99/completed brief
- web-change-intelligence — deterministic webpage change detection — $0.01/comparison
- web-metadata-intelligence — OG, JSON-LD, canonical, robots, headings — $0.01/URL
- article-content-intelligence — clean article extraction for AI/RAG — $0.002/article
- pdf-text-intelligence — PDF text and per-page extraction — $0.0015/PDF
- sitemap-intelligence — sitemap discovery and crawl URL extraction — $0.0001/emitted URL
